reason: ₹4,999 upfront and then ₹999 every month is a subscription, and I avoid those. My register and WhatsApp cost me nothing, and with 3 chairs I can see who is in which chair just by standing in the shop.
objection: I pay ₹999 every month forever, and the reminders and wallet only work if customers give their mobile number. Many of mine won't, so half the features are useless to me.
would_change_my_mind: No monthly fee: one payment of around ₹3,000 for life, or my distributor including it free with my monthly supplies order.
